description: Use this when someone asks who holds a big stake in a company (5%, or the lower threshold some markets use), whether anyone crossed above or below it, or whether an activist has taken a position. Give it the ticker or name. Returns holders above the threshold by their latest notice with percent held and stated intent where the market asks for it, and notices newest first with dates, each holder's 6ix page and the filing; it names the threshold and since when 6ix holds the market's notices.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

name: get_company_substantial_holders

registered.description: Holders at or above the threshold in the register of the company's home market, each as of its own latest notice

window.description: from: the first day of 6ix's unbroken record of the market's notices (null when 6ix doesn't read them); threshold: the market's first threshold

title: Big stakes and activists
